## Evidence limits recorded with the transcript

- The transcript shows user-visible behaviour only. It does not establish internal causes.
- The user reports three approval clicks. Whether the backend received, accepted or consumed them is unknown until the callback records are inspected.
- The 11:12 message claims work was "running" and that an objective was already in progress. Whether that objective existed, and in what state, is unverified until the objective record is found.
- No artifact or completed objective appears in the transcript.
- Two of the messages (09:36 and 09:53 and 10:59) repeat the same approval request word for word. The 09:53 and 10:59 copies may be duplicate deliveries of one prompt or separate prompts. The investigation must determine which.
